id, version_no, language, content_locale, total_score, passed, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id, phase_index, problem_slug FROM practice_session WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

WITH next_version AS ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) + 1 AS version_no FROM practice_code_review WHERE practice_session_id = #{sessionId} ) INSERT INTO practice_code_review ( user_id, plan_id, phase_index, problem_slug, practice_session_id, version_no, user_message_id, assistant_message_id, agent_run_id, raw_code, normalized_code, language, content_locale, detection_evidence_json, context_summary, total_score, correctness_score, complexity_score, edge_case_score, code_quality_score, problem_fit_score, passed, deduction_reasons_json, improvement_suggestions_json, review_markdown ) SELECT #{userId}, #{planId}, #{phaseIndex}, #{problemSlug}, #{sessionId}, next_version.version_no, #{userMessageId}, #{assistantMessageId}, #{agentRunDbId}, #{rawCode}, #{normalizedCode}, #{language}, #{contentLocale}, #{detectionEvidenceJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{contextSummary}, #{totalScore}, #{correctnessScore}, #{complexityScore}, #{edgeCaseScore}, #{codeQualityScore}, #{problemFitScore}, #{passed}, #{deductionReasonsJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{improvementSuggestionsJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{reviewMarkdown} FROM next_version RETURNING
SELECT tag_id FROM practice_code_review_tag WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY tag_id
mapper.sql: review.id AS review_id, review.problem_slug, review.version_no, review.total_score, review.correctness_score, review.complexity_score, review.edge_case_score, review.code_quality_score, review.problem_fit_score, review.passed, review.deduction_reasons_json::TEXT AS deduction_reasons_json, review.improvement_suggestions_json::TEXT AS improvement_suggestions_json, COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(review_tag.tag_id ORDER BY review_tag.tag_id)::TEXT FROM practice_code_review_tag review_tag WHERE review_tag.review_id = review.id ), '[]') AS affected_tag_ids_json, review.created_at
mapper.select: WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (review.problem_slug) review.id FROM practice_code_review review WHERE review.user_id = #{userId} AND review.problem_slug IN #{problemSlug} ORDER BY review.problem_slug ASC, review.created_at DESC, review.id DESC ) SELECT FROM practice_code_review review JOIN latest ON latest.id = review.id ORDER BY review.created_at DESC, review.id DESC
mapper.sql: review.id AS review_id, review.problem_slug, review.version_no, review.total_score, review.correctness_score, review.complexity_score, review.edge_case_score, review.code_quality_score, review.problem_fit_score, review.passed, review.deduction_reasons_json::TEXT AS deduction_reasons_json, review.improvement_suggestions_json::TEXT AS improvement_suggestions_json, COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(review_tag.tag_id ORDER BY review_tag.tag_id)::TEXT FROM practice_code_review_tag review_tag WHERE review_tag.review_id = review.id ), '[]') AS affected_tag_ids_json, review.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT , review.detection_evidence_json::TEXT AS detection_evidence_json, review.context_summary FROM practice_code_review review WHERE review.user_id = #{userId} AND review.id = #{reviewId}

SELECT review.id AS review_id, review.problem_slug, review.version_no, review.normalized_code FROM practice_code_review review WHERE review.user_id = #{userId} AND review.id IN #{reviewId} ORDER BY review.version_no ASC, review.id ASC
